summary: John's 7th-great-grandmother per the tree; wife of Johann Casper Doll.
bio: Shown in the tree as 'Anna M. Dietz' 1724-1790 with a gravestone image; recorded as 'Margaret' in the 1757 Tohickon Reformed baptism of daughter Anna Catharine. WikiTree (Dietz-563) gives her birthplace as Zweibrücken without a source (speculative); several Dietz families from Eschweiler and Rieschweiler in Zweibrücken settled in Plainfield Twp.
sources: Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)
